description.value: The study examined behavioral, autonomic, and neural effects of cognitive reappraisal and acceptance while regulating responses to personally salient autobiographical negative self-beliefs in healthy adults.

spans.text: The focus of this study was to examine the differential impact of two distinct emotion regulation strategies—cognitive reappraisal and acceptance—in the context of reacting to idiographic negative self-beliefs embedded in autobiographical narratives.

value: compared with reacting to negative self-beliefs, both reappraisal and acceptance would result in decreases in self-reported negative emotion, heart rate, respiration rate, skin conductance, and amygdala responses
